title: Pivot Charpy orientations with duplicate means
scenario: Lervani Lab records 40 fictitious Charpy replicates. Pair_key contains text sample_no and heat_no separated by |; neither identifier contains that delimiter. Aggregate numeric replicates by both keys and normalized orientation; all-blank groups return Missing, and measured zero is retained.

lesson.intro: A formula pivot organizes one key across rows and another across columns. A custom aggregation can distinguish numeric measurements from an all-blank group.

functions.name: PIVOTBY
functions.purpose: Aggregate across row and column keys.
functions.arguments: Row/column fields group aligned values; function aggregates. Headers: 0 none, 1 input hidden, 2 generated, 3 input shown (default auto). Row/column total depth: 0 none, ±1 grand, ±2 subtotals (negative at top; default auto). Signed sort indices order axes; filter_array includes rows. For two-argument aggregators, relative_to: 0 column, 1 row, 2 grand, 3 parent column, 4 parent row total.
functions.useCase: Place Charpy orientations side by side.
functions.mistake: Column labels remain part of the pivot result. Define blank and duplicate rules.

functions.name: COUNT
functions.arguments: value1 supplies a value or range; optional arguments add inputs.
functions.mistake: Zero counts; text and blanks in references do not.

lesson.combine: Review LAMBDA, ROUND, DROP, TEXTBEFORE and TEXTAFTER. PIVOTBY retains an orientation-label row: remove it when the task requests data only. Use ascending row/column keys and zero total depths. If unavailable, use a key scaffold with guarded AVERAGEIFS; equivalent outputs are accepted.

tasks.prompt: Group by Pair_key and return Pair_key plus numeric Energy_J count (10 × 2). Sort key ascending; no headers/totals. Zero counts as numeric.
Return Pair_key, LPA_mean_J and TWA_mean_J (10 × 3), key ascending, with no orientation-label row or totals. Round numeric means to two decimals; return Missing for all-blank groups.
Split the task-2 Pair_key and assemble sample_no, heat_no, LPA_mean_J and TWA_mean_J (10 × 4), same row order. Preserve text sample identifiers.
Count Missing orientation means in the task-2 result. Do not count blank raw replicates.

bonus.prompt: Review COUNT: return the number of numeric raw Energy_J measurements.

columns.name: sample_no
columns.description: Leading-zero text identifier, reused across heats.

columns.name: Orientation
columns.description: LPA/TWA with case and outer-space differences.

columns.name: Energy_J
columns.description: Numeric joules or blank unmeasured replicate.

columns.name: Pair_key
columns.description: Lossless sample_no|heat_no text key; delimiters never occur in either component.
